Tokens.//SigningKey: Base64, at least 32 bytes. Read only in Development, from user-secrets; a Development run with none configured mints a throwaway one and says so in the log. A deployment reads the key from KeyVaultUri (secret sync-token-signing-key, local ADR 0058).
Tokens.//KeyVaultUri: The vault the signing key and the GitHub OAuth client secret are read from with the managed identity. Required outside Development; infra/sync/main.bicep sets it.

Connector.//Issuer: The service's public origin, no path: the remote connector's OAuth issuer (RFC 8414). Required outside Development, where it defaults to http://localhost; infra/sync/main.bicep sets it. Local ADR 0058 §8.
Connector.//Resource: The /mcp resource URL every connector access token is for. Required outside Development, where it defaults to <Issuer>/mcp.

Attachments.//AllowedContentTypes: Media types an upload may declare, replacing the built-in list (images, PDF, text, Markdown, CSV, Office Open XML) when set. Local ADR 0014.

Transcription.//Endpoint: The Foundry account endpoint the dictation relay calls. Unset, the route answers 503 and phones dictate on the device. Local ADR 0045.
Transcription.//ContentTypes: Audio types a recording may declare, replacing the built-in list (audio/mp4, audio/x-m4a, audio/webm, audio/wav, audio/mpeg) when set.
Transcription.//Credential: ManagedIdentity (the default, deployed) or None (the local stand-in).
